definitions.explanation: The period when the sun is up; the hours between morning and evening.

examples.japanese: {日中|にっちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧。
examples.english: It's hot during the day, but cool at night.

examples.japanese: {日中|にっちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: I'm busy with work during the day.
The doctor told me I shouldn't go outside during the day.

examples.japanese: {日中|にっちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{買い物|かいもの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}き→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{家事|かじ}→家事：12313_kaji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: During the day, I drop the kids off at school, then go shopping, and do housework until the evening.

notes:
USAGE: {日中|にっちゅう} refers to daytime hours. Note that with different kanji combinations, this reading can also mean Japan-China ({日中|にっちゅう}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ = Japan-China relations).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {日中|にっちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (during the day)
- {日中|にっちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧ (daytime temperature)
- {日中|にっちゅう}⟦{帯|たい}→帯：noentry⟧ (daytime hours, as a period)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {日中|にっちゅう} - daytime
- ⟦{夜間|やかん}→夜間：04133_yakan⟧ - nighttime
- ⟦{昼間|ひるま}→昼間：01713_hiruma⟧ - daytime (more colloquial)
- ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧ - noon, daytime

NOTE: Context is important to distinguish from {日中|にっちゅう} meaning Japan-China. Weather and time contexts indicate 'daytime'; diplomatic contexts indicate 'Japan-China'.
